claims.statement: Under the declared per-attempt engineering envelope, at least seven of ten finite preparation attempts produce PreparedItem values with probability at least 0.75.
assumptions: Each attempt has bad-event probability at most 0.1 under the engineering envelope.
The bound uses Markov's inequality over the number of bad outcomes and does not assume independent attempts.

claims.statement: All ten finite attempts reach typed outcomes within 15 ms under the declared four-worker and five-millisecond leaf bounds.
assumptions: Ten already-dispatched attempts are available to the four-worker pool.
Every attempt reaches one declared typed outcome within five milliseconds.
